name: Vim-Optimized Calendar TUI
title: Vim-Optimized Calendar TUI
description: A comprehensive calendar Terminal User Interface application with full calendar features optimized for vim motions. The calendar should support viewing, creating, editing, and deleting events; recurring events; multiple calendar views (day, week, month, year); reminders and notifications; import/export (iCal, CSV); time zone support; search and filtering; color coding by category; keyboard-first navigation with vim-style keybindings for all operations; and a clean, intuitive terminal interface using modern TUI libraries.

userStories.title: Initialize Rust project structure with ratatui
userStories.description: Set up a new Rust project with ratatui, crossterm, and chrono dependencies. Create basic project structure with module organization for calendar, events, views, and UI components.
acceptanceCriteria: Cargo.toml includes ratatui, crossterm, chrono, serde dependencies
Project has src/ directory with modular structure

userStories.title: Design core data models for calendar and events
userStories.description: Define core data structures including Event (id, title, start_time, end_time, description, location, recurring_rules, category, reminders), CalendarEvent with serialization support, and CalendarState for managing current date, view mode, and event list.
acceptanceCriteria: Event struct with all required fields
CalendarState struct for app state management
Unit tests for data model operations

userStories.title: Implement in-memory event storage with CRUD operations
userStories.description: Create an EventStore trait and in-memory implementation supporting create, read, update, delete, and query operations. Support filtering by date range and category.
acceptanceCriteria: EventStore trait defined with CRUD methods
Can query events by date range

userStories.title: Build month calendar view layout
userStories.description: Implement a month view showing a 7x6 grid of dates with current date highlighting and event indicators. Display events for selected date in side panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Month view displays current month calendar grid
Selected date shows details in side panel

userStories.title: Implement vim-style navigation for month view
userStories.description: Add vim-style keybindings for month view: h/j/k/l for navigation within dates, g for go to date, G for go to today, w/e for week navigation, b/f for month navigation, / for search.
acceptanceCriteria: h/l moves between days in same week
w moves to start of week, e to end of week
g prompts for date to jump to

userStories.title: Create event creation modal with vim editing
userStories.description: Implement a modal dialog for creating new events with fields for title, date/time, duration, description, category. Use vim-style editing in text fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens on 'o' key (vim-style for insert)
Title input field with vim-style editing

userStories.title: Implement event editing and deletion
userStories.description: Add ability to edit existing events (e key or Enter on selected event) and delete events (d key or dd for vim-style). Show confirmation before deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting an event and pressing 'e' opens edit modal
Edit modal pre-fills existing event data
Saving updates the event in storage
Pressing 'd' on selected event prompts for confirmation
Confirmed delete removes event from storage

userStories.title: Build week view layout
userStories.description: Implement a week view showing 7 days with time-based slots for each day. Display events as colored blocks in their time slots.
acceptanceCriteria: Week view displays 7 days of current week
Each day shows hourly time slots
Side panel shows selected day's events

userStories.title: Build day view layout
userStories.description: Implement a detailed day view showing hourly time slots for a single day with events as colored blocks. Show full event details in side panel when selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Day view displays hourly slots for selected day
Event details panel shows full information

userStories.title: Build year view layout
userStories.description: Implement a year view showing 12 months in a grid format. Allow quick navigation to any month by selecting and entering.
acceptanceCriteria: Year view displays 12 months in 4x3 grid
Each month shows summary (number of events)
Pressing Enter switches to month view for selected month

userStories.title: Implement view switching with vim keys
userStories.description: Add ability to switch between month, week, day, and year views using keys: 'm' for month, 'w' for week, 'd' for day, 'y' for year. Maintain current date context when switching.
acceptanceCriteria: Current date preserved when switching views
Visual indicator of current view mode

userStories.title: Add vim-style text editing to all input fields
userStories.description: Implement a vim-like text editor widget for all text inputs (event titles, descriptions, search). Support i, a, A, I for insert modes, Esc for normal mode, basic motion keys, y/p for yank/paste.
acceptanceCriteria: Vim mode indicator in input fields
i inserts before cursor, I at start of line
a appends after cursor, A at end of line
All text inputs use consistent vim editing

userStories.title: Implement event color coding by category
userStories.description: Add category system with predefined categories (work, personal, meeting, reminder, etc.). Each category has an associated color for visual distinction in calendar views.
acceptanceCriteria: Events display with their category color
Color scheme is visually distinct and accessible

userStories.title: Add recurring event support
userStories.description: Implement recurring event patterns: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly. Support recurrence rules with exceptions and end dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Recurring events display correctly in all views
Editing recurring events modifies all future instances or single instance

userStories.title: Implement reminders and notifications
userStories.description: Add reminder system with time-based alerts. Show in-app notifications when reminders trigger. Support multiple reminder times per event.
acceptanceCriteria: Background timer checks for due reminders
In-app notification popup when reminder triggers
Notification includes event title and time

userStories.title: Add event search with vim-style search
userStories.description: Implement search functionality with '/' key to initiate search, 'n' for next result, 'N' for previous result. Support searching by title, description, and category.

userStories.title: Implement event filtering
userStories.description: Add filtering options to show/hide events by category. Display active filters and provide quick toggle keys.
acceptanceCriteria: View updates to show only filtered events
Quick keys for common filters (f1, f2, etc.)

userStories.title: Add timezone support
userStories.description: Implement timezone handling using chrono-tz. Display times in user's local timezone. Support viewing in different timezones.
acceptanceCriteria: Events stored in UTC or with timezone info

userStories.title: Implement iCal import/export
userStories.description: Add ability to import events from iCal (.ics) files and export events to iCal format. Support standard iCal RFC 5545.
acceptanceCriteria: Export includes all events in iCal format

userStories.title: Implement CSV import/export
userStories.description: Add CSV import/export for events. Define CSV format with headers for title, start, end, description, category.
acceptanceCriteria: Export writes CSV with all events
Import reads CSV and creates events
Choice to merge or replace on import

userStories.title: Add command palette (vim :command style)
userStories.description: Implement a command palette triggered by ':' key showing available commands. Support commands like :q to quit, :w to save (if persistence added), :view m for month view, :goto [date], etc.
acceptanceCriteria: Execute command by selecting and pressing Enter
Help command shows all available commands

userStories.title: Add persistent event storage
userStories.description: Implement file-based storage for events to persist between sessions. Store events in JSON format in user's config directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Events saved to config directory JSON file
Create config directory if not exists

userStories.title: Implement configuration file support
userStories.description: Add configuration file for user preferences: default view, colors, keybindings, timezone, default category. Use TOML or YAML format.
acceptanceCriteria: Config file in user config directory
Default values if config doesn't exist
Settings: default_view, theme colors, keybindings overrides, timezone

userStories.title: Add visual themes support
userStories.description: Implement multiple color themes (dark, light, solarized, etc.) with theme selection via config or command palette.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme applies to all UI elements

userStories.title: Add help system
userStories.description: Implement a help screen showing all keybindings and commands. Accessible via '?' key or :help command.
acceptanceCriteria: Help shows all keybindings organized by context
Help is comprehensive but not overwhelming

userStories.title: Add keyboard command mode with visual feedback
userStories.description: Implement visual mode with 'v' key for selecting multiple events or dates. Support vim-style visual selection with motion keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual mode indicator in status bar

userStories.title: Add undo/redo functionality
userStories.description: Implement undo and redo for event operations. Use 'u' for undo, 'Ctrl+r' for redo following vim conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: Redo stack cleared on new action

userStories.title: Add calendar integration hints (iCal URLs)
userStories.description: Support subscribing to remote iCal feeds. Periodically sync events from external calendars.
acceptanceCriteria: Merge external events with local events

userStories.title: Implement copy/paste of events
userStories.description: Add ability to copy events (yy or visual selection + y) and paste to new dates (p). Support date adjustment on paste.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual selection + y copies multiple events
'p' pastes copied events at selected date
Prompt to adjust pasted event times
Paste to different date adjusts event dates

userStories.title: Add event templates
userStories.description: Create system for event templates (meeting, appointment, task, etc.). Quick-create events from templates with predefined settings.

userStories.title: Add status bar
userStories.description: Implement a status bar at the bottom of the screen showing current view mode, selected date, event count for current view, and current time. Mode indicator with vim-style notation (NORMAL, INSERT, etc.).
acceptanceCriteria: Status bar displays at bottom of screen
Shows event count for current period

userStories.title: Apply category colors in UI
userStories.description: Render events with their associated category colors in all views (month indicators, week/day blocks, event lists). Define default color palette for common categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Default color palette defined (Work=blue, Personal=green, Meeting=yellow, etc.)
Events display with category color in side panel
Event indicators in month view use category color
Week/day view event blocks use category color
